# Sources this skill cites

Each entry gives the exact quote relied on and the date it was checked. If a **Re-check by** date has passed, or the rule is an SBA rule, tell the user it may have changed and to confirm the current version (for SBA rules, the current SOP 50 10 and their lender).

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-dsc-ratio

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15 (7(a) Changes of Ownership), Para. C.2: debt service coverage, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** For a 7(a) change of ownership, the lender tests debt service coverage on the last fiscal year-end or the average of the last two, at 1.25:1 for an initial acquisition or owner buyout and 1.15:1 for a business expansion.
- **Quote:** "The Debt Service Coverage (DSC) ratio must be satisfied using either the last fiscal year-end or an average of the last two fiscal year-end statements on either a historical or adjusted basis based on the transaction type: Initial Acquisition: 1.25:1 Business Expansion: 1.15:1 Owner Buyout: 1.25:1 ESOP and Cooperative: 1.25:1"
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-equity-minimum

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15, Para. C.2.a: minimum equity injection, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** A buyer making an initial acquisition must inject at least 10% equity, and the lender cannot reduce or waive it.
- **Quote:** "Initial Acquisition: 10%. For Initial Acquisitions, the required equity injection cannot be reduced or eliminated."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-qoe-not-for-seller

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15: QoE performed for the lender, not the seller, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** An SBA-required quality of earnings report must be independent, done for the lender, and not prepared by or for the seller.
- **Quote:** "The QoE must be performed by an independent, experienced financial professional and must be conducted for the benefit of the Lender. As the QoE report is part of the financial due diligence of the transaction, the report must not be prepared by or for the seller."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-qoe-threshold

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15: Quality of Earnings required at $3 million, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** For 7(a) initial acquisitions and business expansions with a business purchase price of $3 million or more, the lender must obtain a quality of earnings report as well as the business valuation, measured before equity, seller debt or other financing.
- **Quote:** "For Business Expansion and Initial Acquisition transactions where the Purchase Price as defined in Paragraph A.1 is equal to or greater than $3 million, the Lender must also obtain a Quality of Earnings (QoE) in addition to the required Business Valuation. The $3 million threshold is determined before the application of buyer equity, seller debt, or other financing sources."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## sba-sop-50-10-8-1-valuation-for-lender

- **Source:** SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 15: business valuation prepared for the lender, U.S. Small Business Administration
- **URL:** https://legacy.sba.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/SOP%2050%2010%208.1%20Technical%20Policy%20Updates%20effective%20%2010.1.2026.docx
- **Supports:** The SBA business valuation must be ordered by and prepared for the lender; one prepared for the buyer or seller can't be used.
- **Quote:** "For the individual performing the business valuation to identify the scope of work appropriately, the business valuation must be requested by and prepared for the Lender. The Lender may not use a business valuation prepared for the Applicant or the seller."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26
